title: HtmlPre
responsibility: Renders the native pre element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlPre.attributes
inputs.description: Native pre attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlPre.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native pre element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlPre
outputs.description: The actual native pre element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
